# T001: Health page that polls /healthz

## Goal
When this task is done, `/health` serves a static page that calls `/healthz` every ten seconds and shows a green dot when it answers 200 and a red dot otherwise, with the time of the last poll.

## Target files
- src/pages/health.html
- src/server.ts
- test/health.test.ts

## Contracts
None.

## Out of scope
- Anything beyond the one page.

## Notes for the worker
This brief has no acceptance-criteria section on purpose: the planner writes the criteria for this task, and a decision records that it did. Serve the page from `src/server.ts` next to the other static routes and keep the script inline so there is no build step.
